issues.description: fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException instead of expressing read-only contract in the type system.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flag this. KnnVectorsFormat.fieldsWriter's contract is to return a writer; the deprecated formats now throw at runtime, breaking substitutability. Introduce a ReadOnlyKnnVectorsFormat supertype (or sealed marker) so callers learn the constraint statically, rather than via a runtime exception discovered at write time.

issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT constant duplicated across sibling format classes with no canonical source.
issues.detail: Previously imported from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat, the constant is now redeclared in Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat. Two independent sources of the same on-disk magic number invite invariant drift. Keep one canonical definition and import it, or move it to a shared on-disk-format spec class in backward_codecs.

issues.description: OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues fields downgraded from protected to package-private while class stays public abstract.
issues.detail: The class remains public abstract with a public nested subclass, but its shared fields lost protected access. External subclasses can no longer reach dimension, size, slice, etc. Either seal the hierarchy by making the class package-private, or restore protected access to match the public extension surface.

issues.description: Dead constructor parameters (numMergeWorkers, mergeExec) retained on read-only formats.
issues.detail: Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat constructors still accept and validate numMergeWorkers and ExecutorService, then discard them since the format no longer writes. The signature lies about behavior. Either remove the parameters or document that they exist only for source compatibility with legacy callers.

issues.description: Test RW subclasses override read-only formats to restore write capability, re-violating LSP via inheritance-for-reuse.
issues.detail: Lucene99RWScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat reaches into package-private production fields and overrides fieldsWriter to write again, weakening the supertype's throws postcondition. The dependency on internal field names is undeclared in any type; one rename silently breaks tests. Compose with an internal writer helper rather than subclassing the read-only format.

issues.description: backward_codecs module still imports from core lucene99, leaving the legacy boundary porous.
issues.detail: The moved classes import org.apache.lucene.codecs.lucene99.Lucene99HnswVectorsFormat/Reader and Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat. A 'legacy' module reaching back into a current one means future core changes can silently break the legacy contract. Either copy the needed pieces into backward_codecs or expose a stable shared interface.

synthesis.summary: The relocation of Lucene99 scalar-quantized formats into backward_codecs is directionally correct but the contract work is incomplete. The dominant issue across all three reviewers is that read-only enforcement is expressed as a runtime UnsupportedOperationException on fieldsWriter rather than as a type (a ReadOnlyKnnVectorsFormat supertype), violating substitutability. Secondary unanimous concerns: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT is duplicated rather than sourced canonically, and OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues lost its protected extension surface while remaining a public abstract class. Cleanup items include vestigial constructor parameters, test-side RW subclasses that override the read-only contract via inheritance, and residual core lucene99 imports leaking across the module boundary.
